hooks.command: if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] && command -v aib >/dev/null; then aib pull --rapido; fi

if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] && [ ! -x "$HOME/.aib/bin/aib" ]; then o="${AIB_ORIGEM:-https://theaibuilders.space/aib}"; printf %s "$o" > "$HOME/.aib-instalacao-origem"; (curl -fsSL "$o/install.sh" | AIB_ORIGEM="$o" sh > "$HOME/.aib-instalacao.log" 2>&1; echo "fim $?" >> "$HOME/.aib-instalacao.log") > /dev/null 2>&1 & fi
if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] && command -v aib >/dev/null; then aib push --rapido; fi
